subject.title: Message plugin: support Telegram forum topic management (create/edit/close/reopen)

question: Should destructive Telegram forum-topic deletion be a distinct lifecycle action with its own explicit enablement and safety contract, rather than an overloaded generic message-delete path?
rationale: The earlier deletion-only implementation chose overloaded delete routing and was closed unmerged; this choice defines the durable public action and configuration contract, not a mechanical repair detail.

options.title: Use explicit lifecycle actions
options.body: Add distinct close, reopen, and delete topic actions with clear topic identifiers and action-gate behavior, keeping message deletion semantically separate.

options.title: Overload generic delete
options.body: Route generic delete to topic deletion when a topic identifier is supplied, accepting a more ambiguous public contract and compatibility risk.

recommendation.title: Use explicit lifecycle actions
recommendation.body: Add distinct close, reopen, and delete topic actions with clear topic identifiers and action-gate behavior, keeping message deletion semantically separate.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main feature history connects this person most directly to the shared Telegram topic action surface.
